title: What the live paper record shows
description: The engines' own state, read from the running record: what is open, what closed, and what the market filter is doing right now.
body:
Paper signals only. No real orders are placed anywhere in this record. The engines' live records began on different dates, and the figures below are the running state of open positions, closed trades, and market-filter status. One trade, whether open or closed, says nothing about a strategy, and the same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel.

## Live starts and first signals

v005 counts its live record from 1 October 2026 and v006 from 9 October 2026. The first live signal was an ATOM entry at 2.066 after the 10 October 2026 daily close. ATOM exited below its 10-day low at the 18 October 2026 close, at 1.703, which is −17.9% after the 30 bps round trip. The exit rule was triggered by the close below the 10-day low, and the measured result was −17.9% after costs. A NEAR entry at 5.896 on 12 October 2026 has been open since. In testing, losses were common and the average winner was roughly +19%, so a losing start is the expected case rather than a surprise. The record is paper only, and no real orders are placed.

## Open positions and closed trades

htf-rsi-v007 has 0 positions open on paper. htf-rsi-v007 closed trades so far: 4, with an average null net per trade. trend-daily-v005 has 0 positions open on paper and 6 closed trades so far, with an average −13.22% net per trade. trend-daily-v006 has 0 positions open on paper and 7 closed trades so far, with an average −13.34% net per trade. NEAR remains open from 12 October 2026 at 5.896. ATOM is already closed. The closed-trade averages are measurements of what happened, not statements about what will happen.

## Market filter status

trend-daily-v005 has the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper. trend-daily-v006 also has the Bitcoin market filter off and 0 positions open on paper. With both filters off, the record shows no open trend positions. The nearest names to their 20-day breakout levels are: TRXUSDT at 13.34% below its high, XLMUSDT at 17.87% below its high, and AVAXUSDT at 18.82% below its high for v005; and JUPUSDT at 5.46% below its high, TRXUSDT at 13.34% below its high, and XLMUSDT at 17.87% below its high for v006. These distances are where the market is relative to those highs, not forecasts.

## Reading the record

The live snapshot was read at 2026-11-16T15:15:26.518Z. The record updates continuously, and the same numbers appear on the performance page, in the signal log, and in the status posted to the channel. Paper signals only; no real orders are placed. The current state is unproven and inconclusive: a small number of closed trades and one open position cannot establish whether a rule works. Nothing here should be read as advice, a prediction, or a recommendation about any coin or trade.
